comment: Phase 0 workstream E scaffold. Documented but not yet enforced — runProvider's existing fallback signals (fallback:true on quota/timeout/cli-missing) drive routing today. Once /warp:promote-flags drains the dispatch backlog, lift this into runProvider so the chain is honoured automatically.

redteam.rationale: redteam runs adversarial-corpus reasoning; gemini-2.5-flash is the reliable primary (gemini-3-pro-preview quota-fails after 1-2 scans, ROADMAP 2026-05-11), claude-opus is the most capable fallback that won't degrade depth on long attack chains. A SECOND security pass ALWAYS runs on openai:gpt-5.5 (dispatch-agent --provider openai) so security covers two model families and survives a total gemini outage.

reviewer.rationale: GPT-5.5 xhigh is the diversity lens against Claude builders. Falling back to claude-sonnet-4-6 keeps gauntlets moving when codex is unreachable.

qa.rationale: qa runs 13 personas — cost-balanced primary. Haiku fallback keeps per-persona cost predictable on outages.

notes: auth_source_mismatch deliberately does NOT auto-fall-back. The user has set both API key AND OAuth — failing closed surfaces the configuration ambiguity rather than silently using the wrong account.
